description: For any consistent, negation-complete, code-enumerable axiom set \(T\) in an effective signature, the codes of its actual natural-deduction theorems form a decidable set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.enumerable_complete_theory_decidable.{u_1, u_2}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (T : L.Theory)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.CodeEnumerable S T)
  (hk : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T)
  (hc :
    ∀ (A : L.Formula Empty),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A ∨
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A.not) :
  ComputablePred fun n =>
    ∃ A,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode S A = n ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A
